title: Legal Document AI
desc: OCR, retrieval and LLM generation behind a FastAPI and Streamlit app. Every memo cites the documents it used, and operator edits feed back into the next draft.

card.lede: Drafts internal case memos from uploaded legal documents, grounded in what the documents say.
points: Reads scanned PDFs and images with OCR
Each memo is built from the uploaded documents
Your corrections become rules for the next memo
